entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers are expected to affect higher parts of the road late Monday night and early Tuesday morning. Around 1 cm could accumulate above 800 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers may continue about the road overnight Monday into early Tuesday morning. 1 to 3 cm may accumulate about the highest part of the road with lesser amounts down to 100 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited
